items.label: Benefits
items.value: Said to help with neuralgia, muscle pain, joint pain, poor circulation, recovery from illness, cuts, burns, chronic skin conditions, and more, as well as gastrointestinal issues and chronic muscular rheumatism.

items.label: Onsen Characteristics
items.value: Known for its smooth feel on the skin. High heat-retention means you stay warm long after bathing, making it a good choice for elderly guests and families.

items.label: Source Information
items.value: Continuously fed with fresh spring water (kakenagashi), drawn from a source welling up in Toyako Onsen town on the shore of Lake Toya within Shikotsu-Toya National Park.
